records.text: On September 10th, aircraft N582MM left Pierre, South Dakota at 2:40 p.m., landed in Chicago at 4:06 p.m., and then flew to Provo.
records.speaker: Baron Coleman

appearances.snippet: This is September 10th, Chicago to Provo. It had previously been in Pierre. My guess is that Pierre to Chicago flight was a repositioning flight. ... It left Pierre, South Dakota at 2.40 p.m. It landed in Chicago at 4.06 p.m., less than an hour later. ... It left for Provo

verification.notes: Live searches and accessible FAA and flight-tracker pages identified N582MM but did not expose the September 10 historical legs or times. Search results only repeated the podcast account, so the Pierre-Chicago-Provo itinerary could not be independently verified.

records.text: Candace Owens said N582MM left Denver at 11:58 a.m. Mountain Time on September 10, landed at a military base in Pierre at 12:56 p.m., continued to Chicago, and reached Provo at 6:57 p.m.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: The plane departs Denver, Colorado. That's at 11.58 a.m. mountain time. And then it heads to a military base in Pierre, South Dakota. ... It lands at 12.56 p.m. mountain time. ... And then they went straight to Provo, Utah, landing at 6.57 p.m.
